text:
maria: Quick heads up — Nimbus just pinged about onboarding a West-Africa region (west-africa-1, Lagos PoP). Need marketplace SKU entitlements, GPU quota, and KMS approvals by EOD Fri. Planning doc: https://rwd.in/ops/west-africa-onboard :point_right:

 tom: thanks. can you paste the initial capacity numbers? GPUs, vCPUs, expected qps?

 maria: initial target footprint: 4x A10G (pool), burst to 8x. vCPU equivalent ~128 per PoP, expected steady qps ~120 req/s for chat endpoints.

 ade: (Nimbus) Confirmed — marketplace SKU will be NIMB-EDGE-WA1, we can enable billing entitlement on partner side once Redwood approves quotas. ETA for enabling from our side is 48h after approval.

 jess: are there any special compliance bits? data residency? export controls?

 rahul: Legal: need the data residency clause added to the marketplace manifest. Also require KMS attestation doc from Nimbus. I can draft a one-paragraph amendment.

 tom: infra note — prefer to pin model variants to quantized rwd-3b-q for initial rollout to reduce GPU memory. Also want autoscale policy: min=1, target=4, max=8. I'll open infra ticket.

 maria: added infra ticket #OP-4729 and partner onboarding ticket #PRT-983. Linking both here: https://rwd.in/t/OP-4729 https://rwd.in/t/PRT-983

 quota-bot: Quota request 983 submitted to cloud provider for west-africa-1 GPUs (A10G x8). Request ID: Q-2148. Status: pending.

 ade: will start partner-side entitlement flow as soon as Q-2148 is approved. We can also provide a pre-provisioned AMI for quick smoke tests.

 rahul: Maria — share the KMS attestation from Nimbus in the ticket once you get it. I can sign off on the legal text after that.

 jess: Marketing: flag for small joint announcement? if we hit go-live within 2 weeks we can do a short blog + partner tweet. Not locked, just flagging.

 maria: noted. scheduling a 30-min sync tomorrow 10:30PT with infra, partner, and legal to close blockers. Agenda in calendar invite.

 tom: i'll prep the autoscale + model pin PR and drop a short runbook for failover to EU region.

 ade: 👍 will have the AMI and billing entitlement checklist ready by tomorrow morning.

 maria: thanks everyone. action items: tom -> infra PR (#OP-4729), rahul -> legal amendment draft, ade -> KMS attestation + AMI, jess -> draft announcement stub. I'll follow up after tomorrow's sync. :thumbsup:

 tom: quick Q — if the GPU quota is delayed, fallback plan?

 maria: fallback: start with CPU-only footprints (rwd-3b-cpu) behind the EU router for latency tolerant traffic, and scale to GA after GPU quota. we'll document in runbook.

 quota-bot: Update: Q-2148 moved to 'under review' by cloud provider (expected 48-72h).
